releaseNotes: New: NBAbite and TotalSportek game pages, new sources of NBA, NFL, NHL, soccer and cricket games that open only the working mirror links. New: Bitcq, a new magnet search index (Settings > Sources). Improved: game names with a misspelled team still match (a listing's "Canadeins" now finds the Canadiens game); more Pirate Bay site fallbacks and a YTS mirror.
